text:
marta: Quick alert, p99 spike in continuous-batcher ~3m, tenant 'alpha' burst correlation. thoughts on queue ownership?
kieran: numbers?
marta: p50 ~12ms, p99 jumped 120->900ms. enqueue logs show long wait (queue_len ~60).
joy: two paths: per-tenant micro-lanes (isolate) or shared lanes + soft isolation (pack). micro-lanes risk fragmentation.
ben: tradeoffs: micro-lanes = clearer SLOs but scheduler complexity; shared = better GPU utilization, trickier eviction.
kieran: we lack lane-level histograms for easy ops. will need telemetry work.
joy: proposal: try "headroom tickets" per tenant in shared lane. tickets cap short bursts, regen slowly. keeps packing intact.
ben: caution: many small requests could slowly consume tickets. need leak detection and fairbackoff.
derek: safe rollout plan: 1) add telemetry + FF, 2) enable tickets for 10% tenants, 3) measure p50/p95/p99, occupancy, cost. rollback rules?
marta: rollback if p99 >2x baseline or GPU occupancy drops >15% or packing loss >10%.
kieran: also add deadline_hint enforcement: coalesce should favor smaller deadline_hint via deadline_bias factor.
joy: we have deadline_hint in SDK; need admission enforcement.
ben: token_estimates used in ordering are noisy; log misorders for later tuning.
derek: ensure no public API changes; internal FF only.
ops-bot: Incident IN-2026-03-22-11 logged and assigned to marta.
marta: Action items: kieran telemetry schema; joy simulate tickets; ben draft eviction/ordering; derek write canary runbook. If tickets fail, fallback: limited-scope micro-lanes with automatic compaction (merge cold lanes).
kieran: I'll write a short RFC follow-up with metrics schema.
joy: TL;DR: try soft-reservation + deadline_bias first; micro-lanes as fallback. :thumbsup:
